methods.name: Pixel-based change detection with fuzzy membership functions
methods.summary: A pixel-based change detection method that uses NDVI, slope, and VDCN as covariates. Fuzzy membership functions (S-shaped and Z-shaped curves) are applied to these covariates to identify landslide scars, with NDVI weighted more heavily. The resulting fuzzy maps are aggregated, and binary landslide maps are produced based on optimality thresholds.
methods.source: Jaco Kotzé, Jay Le Roux, Johan van Tol
methods.verbatim: In this study, a pixel-based change detection approach with fuzzy membership functions was employed to map landslide scars in both the Pinetown and Port St. Johns areas of South Africa.

reproducibility_assessment: The input datasets are accessible via public portals, but the landslide inventory is not linked or made available. The custom code used for the method is not provided or linked.
